description: Scans up to fifteen table entries for one whose byte at offset 55 matches the argument, and returns without a result. It does nothing when the argument is not positive.

description: Moves non-empty entries in a pointer table up to fill empty slots, then sorts the table by the byte at offset six of each entry, largest first.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:009C

description: Sorts a pointer table in place by the byte at offset six of each entry, placing the largest value first. It makes no other changes to the entries.

description: Allocates a memory block through the Exec library and stores its pointer, returning an error code when the allocation returns nothing. key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0242

description: Allocates a buffer through the Exec library and stores it in a slot chosen by a counter, returning an error code when allocation fails. key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0314

description: Claims the blitter and computes first- and last-word masks from the low nibble of a value. It sets the pointers, control words and sizes, then issues one blit for each entry in a pointer list, switching the control word between runs, and finally releases the blitter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:03AC
name: swap_record_fields_around_call
description: Saves two record fields, replaces one with a supplied pointer and sets the other to one, then stores two fixed control words around a call to another routine. It restores the saved fields afterwards.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:04BC

description: Walks a table of three-byte entries until a sentinel, writing the index of each entry marked with the second value into a buffer and counting them in a global. It then clears one trailing byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:04FC
name: blit_grid_cells_from_index_list
description: Claims the blitter and loops over a list of cell indices, splitting each index into a row and a column by dividing it by thirteen. For each cell it computes source and destination addresses from a fixed row stride and starts a blit of a fixed size, then releases the blitter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0620
name: update_object_list_and_dma
description: Turns blitter DMA on, then walks a table of object records, updating each object's flags for the current alternating flag value and computing its position from its fields. It processes the chained objects and turns the blitter DMA off again at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0838
name: build_scaled_bit_mask_rows
description: Clears ten longwords, then walks two dimension tables with an accumulator that steps by a scaled width and sets a bit in a mask each time it passes one thousand. It stores the count of set bits along each axis and returns early when either count is zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:084C

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0860
name: unpack_packed_bitplane_rows
description: Builds a row mask from two dimension tables with a scaled accumulator, then unpacks a bit-packed plane into the destination in one of two modes chosen by a flag. The decompiled text is cut off partway through the second mode.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0A36

description: Copies rows of bytes from a source through a lookup table, reading each source byte as an index, with a row stride and per-row counts. It enables blitter DMA through a control write at the end and calls two routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0CDA

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:3:0D2C

description: Reads console input one character at a time and echoes each accepted character with a dos Write call. Backspace removes the last character, Enter ends the line, and only digits and letters are accepted up to a count. When a yes or no answer is needed, only the Y and N forms are accepted.
